summary.text:
# 抗病毒 / Anti-Virus

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Necroids · 来源 Sources：`events/necroids_events_2.txt:536-557`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1467` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

舰船被击毁时（on_ship_destroyed_perp，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1467）：触发者是拥有“虫草工蜂”国民理念（civic_hive_cordyceptic_drones）的普通国家，被毁方来自“虫群”类国家（from 的类型为 swarm，即普罗索林/天灾类入侵者）；fire_only_once，整局仅一次。

When a ship is destroyed (on_ship_destroyed_perp, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1467): a normal empire with the Cordyceptic Drones civic (civic_hive_cordyceptic_drones) whose counterpart is a swarm-type country (an invader such as the Prethoryn); fire_only_once, so once per game.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一窗口“抗病毒”：普罗索林试图侵入我们的 [necromancers]，外来实体开始采集信息；唯一选项“必须将它们灭绝”，无额外效果。

A single window "Anti-Virus": the Prethoryn tried to enter our necromancers and began collecting data; the only option, They need to be exterminated, has no further effect.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。

No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

仅虫草工蜂国民理念。

Cordyceptic Drones only.
